title: Graduate Application, 2026-2027 Spring Semester (Graduate School of Social Sciences)
institution: Middle East Technical University (METU), Graduate School of Social Sciences
about: METU's Graduate School of Social Sciences in Ankara accepts applications to its master's and doctoral programmes for the 2026-2027 Spring semester from 23 November to 18 December 2026 (23:59). Results are announced on 22 January 2027.
requirements: Some programmes require GRE or equivalent; conditional admission may be possible without it
Applications are taken and evaluated by the graduate schools
